fusions.name: Paring Pass
fusions.desc: A quick slash that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snip the Tie
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 60% of their remaining damage to this blow for each one, which deals 20 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Slipped Hem
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Edge Kept Close
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%.
